# Advisories audit.yml does not fail on, one per line:
#
#   <advisory id>  <why it does not apply or cannot be fixed yet>; <date>, <who>
#
# Only the first word of a line is read (passed as pip-audit --ignore-vuln).
# An entry is a decision a person made and can be asked about, not a way to
# make the workflow green: name the reason (code path not reached, no fixed
# release, fix blocked by a pin in pyproject.toml), and remove the line when
# the reason stops holding. Empty on 2026-10-15: the closure of
# ".[agent,docs]" (171 distributions) had no known advisory.
